messages:
amanda: FYI customer report — they saw two charges for a single streaming call that retried after a toolcall. attaching quick logs in thread.

sam: oof, can you paste the request/session ids?

amanda: request=rQ_8f3b, session=s-9c2, trace snippets below:
```
2026-03-19T14:22:01Z INFO  start stream id=rQ_8f3b model=redwood-v1 route=A
2026-03-19T14:22:02Z INFO  toolcall mailer invoked token_offset=+12
2026-03-19T14:22:03Z WARN  client truncated stream (early_eof)
2026-03-19T14:22:03Z INFO  reconnect attempt id=rQ_8f3b-1 route=B (fallback)
2026-03-19T14:22:04Z INFO  provisional charge created ledger=proto-xyz amount=+13
2026-03-19T14:22:05Z INFO  confirmed charge created ledger=proto-abc amount=+13
```

diego: looks like both ledgers ended up confirmed in different paths — router fallback created a new confirmed charge without deduping the provisional from the first route. probably because the reconnect lost the original idempotency header.

sam: is the toolcall TTL/commit boundary causing the provisional->confirmed transition before the recon?

diego: yeah. current flow: prefix capture -> toolcall -> commit provisional -> client truncation -> reconnect -> fallback route publishes a separate commit. missing session tag allows double-commit.

tess: UX question — ops asks to be able to distinguish provisional vs confirmed charges in the Console so they can spot these spikes. right now Console only shows net billed tokens per trace.

amanda: immediate ask from support: surface pending/provisional credits on the charge line + link to trace so they can see if a reconnect happened.

console-bot: created FE story FE-3789 "show provisional credits + pending state in Billing row" assigned to @tess.

sam: backend telemetry note — can we add counters: `stream.reconnect.provisional_dups` and `toolcall.truncation.overlap`? Would help quantify impact.

diego: I can add the metrics and a small router fix: forward `X-Session-Id` and use it as the dedupe key for reconnects. I'll own backend PR.

tess: for Console I'll add a new column "pending" (boolean/count) and a hover tooltip: "Pending = provisional credits not yet reconciled to confirmed charges". also add a link to the raw trace. estimate 3 days to prototype, 2 sprints for polish.

amanda: for short-term mitigation can we mark provisional credits in the billing UI with a yellow warning and not count them in customer invoices until confirmed? ops wants to avoid refunds.

diego: agree — add a `pending` tag that hides provisional from invoices; billing pipeline already supports `state` tag. small change.

amanda: I'll attach full repro and screenshots to the incident.

billing-bot: incident created incident-789: "double charge on stream reconnect w/ toolcall truncation". severity=P2.

sam: next steps summary: (1) diego backend PR to forward X-Session-Id + dedupe logic + metrics, (2) tess FE story FE-3789 to surface provisional/pending in Console, (3) amanda attach repro + hold invoices for customer while we investigate.

diego: ETA for backend patch: PR by EOD tomorrow, rollout next week behind feature flag.

tess: ETA for FE prototype: end of this week.

amanda: thanks — ping me once PR is up. I'll coordinate with support to freeze invoices.

sam: noted. reassign followups in sprint board. :thumbsup:

amanda: one more thing — we should add an automated alert if provisional/confirmed ratio for a route > 1.2 for 5m. helps catch regressions.

diego: good idea, will add alert rule to telemetry playbook.

console-bot: FE-3789 updated with acceptance criteria and mockups.

billing-bot: tagging billing-team for visibility.

all: :thumbsup:
